svg.text: or pick the two schedules here
2nd tab: success vs latency per h
shade = how much more often the candidate
succeeds on the same start states
dark frame = unlikely to be chance
click a cell = compare that pair
hover = rates, rescued / lost start states, chance level
row = one start state (30) of the chosen pair
filled cell = success · rows grouped by where the two disagree
② drag over rows = select those start states → A recomputes
③ click a row → C and D replay that start state
the table seen from above · both schedules side by side, same moment
Baseline: standing still, waiting for a new plan
Candidate: moving, its plan is k steps old
grey T = block · dashed T = goal · ● = pusher · solid = moves done · dashed = rest of the plan
← → step · hover a point = when planned
red bar = jump at a chunk switch · time →
sync: think, then act · async: think while acting
click = move time cursor (C follows) · hover a chunk = its plan in C · window = that path in C
